verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's HyperAgent lets users write natural-language commands instead of selectors, such as `page.ai("search for flights... select the cheapest option")`, and `page.extract()` takes natural-language data requests. Its agents API starts AI-driven browser tasks with a single call, supports Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and BrowserUse agents, and an official MCP server lets AI models drive scraping, extraction and crawling. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, and evidence of natural-language operation outside code or API calls (e.g. a direct conversational interface).
